talks.title: Meditation
talks.description: Meditation is talk 1 of 12 in The Enlightenment Cycle series (1992). Rama on making the mind calm and quiet, and meditating to enlightened music.

talks.title: Intermediate Meditation
talks.description: Talk 11 of 12 in The Enlightenment Cycle series (1992).
quotes: Meditation is concentration in the beginning. It’s a focus. Then, in the intermediate stage, it’s an opening, a deepening of one’s awareness but with a focus towards the planes of light. In intermediate meditation, you’re touching light more deeply than in introductory meditation. In advanced meditation, you become light. You transcend self, ego, time, space, dimensionality. You merge with the clear light of reality and you go beyond this world.

talks.title: Advanced Meditation
talks.description: Talk 22 of 28 in the Lakshmi Series.
quotes: In advanced meditation, we not only pass through other planes of consciousness or awareness but we become them.

talks.title: Awareness of Meditation
talks.description: Talk 13 of 27 in the Tantric Buddhism series (February 1990).
quotes: Meditation is the science of stopping thought. When there is no thought, there is only pure mind – which is ecstasy. Meditation is perfect, qualityless, clear light perceiving itself as such.

talks.title: Consciousness Expansion and Desire
talks.description: Part of Rama Live In LA, talks recorded before a live audience in February 1983.
talks.localFile: Rama Live LA/01 - Consciousness Expansion and Desire.mp3
quotes: The world is constantly imprinting us. It’s imprinting us with ideas, beliefs, vibrational forms, all kinds of things. And the imprinting is so constant and so powerful, that it’s necessary for us to allow Eternity to imprint ourselves in a slightly different way. So when we have one of these moments, the longer we can meditate upon it, the longer we can keep it in our cumulative consciousness, the stronger in a sense it will become. Because the moment is not really a moment. Rather, it’s an entrance into another plane of reality, and that plane of reality is always available.

talks.title: Cosmic Awareness
talks.description: Part of Rama Live In LA, talks recorded before a live audience in February 1983.
quotes: Cosmic awareness is the realization that we’re light. That each one of us is light. As we progress in our inundation with light, as we make friends with light, and we come to know it better, we come to know our substance and our essence, then we find that we’re not really separate beings of light.

talks.title: Reincarnation & the Tibetan Rebirth Process
talks.description: Live talk on Reincarnation and the Tibetan Rebirth Process. Part of Rama Live In LA, talks recorded before a live audience in February 1983.
talks.localFile: Rama Live LA/03 - Reincarnation and the Tibetan Rebirth Process.mp3
quotes: So the Tibetan Rebirth Process, essentially, is the transition from the human phase into the supra-human. It’s the transition that you will make when you go beyond the human fields of attention into the supraconscious and move through the various stages of enlightenment.

And it’s possible to do that within a given lifetime. To do something uncommon in existence. And that’s to go off the map. What’s out there? Who knows, it can’t be described. But that’s the journey of existence.

talks.title: Tantric Mysticism & Meditation
talks.description: Live talk on Tantric Mysticism & Meditation. Part of Rama Live In LA, talks recorded before a live audience in February 1983.
talks.localFile: Rama Live LA/05 - Tantric Mysticism and Meditation.mp3
quotes: Tantric mysticism is the networking of spiritual practices. Tantric mysticism, in shorthand, is living in the world and attaining enlightenment.
Meditation is the process of becoming conscious of the part of ourselves that knows everything. Meditation is a bridge, between the awareness that we have now, and infinite awareness.

talks.title: For Every Ending There Is a New Beginning
talks.description: Part of Rama Live In LA, talks recorded before a live audience in February 1983.
talks.localFile: Rama Live LA/06 - For Every Ending There Is a New Beginning.mp3
quotes: The idea that there’s a past and a future is illusory. Which does not mean that there is not a past and a future. There is a past and a future in this world in relative time. Then, of course, there’s timeless time. That realm of existence that’s not defined in the Superconscious. True awareness. When we experience the ultimate reality, without words, without hidden meanings. But between the superconscious and the conscious, there’s a space, a gap, which each one of us experiences on the way towards the transcendental reality. It’s the journey that we make called self-discovery.

talks.title: On Meditation 1
talks.description: Practice text from the Meditation page (not individually attributed on the page).
talks.text: Meditation is the process of silencing our thoughts. When we meditate, we are simply letting go and allowing ourselves to dissolve back into that which we really are.

talks.title: On Meditation 2
talks.description: Practice text from the Meditation page (not individually attributed on the page).
talks.text: The practice of meditation is emptying the mind . When the mind is empty, completely empty, that is perfect meditation.

talks.title: On Meditation 3
talks.description: Practice text from the Meditation page (not individually attributed on the page).
talks.text: Meditation is a bright, hopeful practice in which we learn to make our minds quiet so that the infinite, perfect light of enlightenment can flow through us. When we meditate, we get in touch with the deepest part of ourselves. Beyond the world of thought and sensorial impressions, there are planes and dimensions of perfect light, knowledge, and radiant perfection.

talks.title: On Meditation 4
talks.description: Practice text from the Meditation page (not individually attributed on the page).
talks.text: Meditation is a process of moving our awareness from this world – from the awareness of time and space – into eternity and eternal dimensions.

talks.title: On Meditation 5
talks.description: Practice text from the Meditation page (not individually attributed on the page).
talks.text: Meditation is about being still, being centered, being clear, being happy, and being organically in touch with the universal light. Meditation is about developing parts of ourselves that are unknown to most people, very powerful parts, very beautiful parts, very strong parts.

talks.title: On Meditation 6
talks.description: Practice text from the Meditation page (not individually attributed on the page).
talks.text: For years we practice meditation, like any art, and we get better at it each day. When we meditate we are accessing eternity. We are plugging ourselves into the source of light, beauty, and perfection.
